selection.train: Preserve four engineering rows first; then fill eight RAW-correct and eight RAW-incorrect TRAIN rows in SHA order, globally distinct components preferred
selection.probe: First eight original outer-held query IDs by SHA; no label, target-presence, or group filtering
selection.probe_component_count: Only report at post-prediction label join

frozen_head.feature_definition: raw gap uses population std over C128; sym(a,b)=(a-b)/(|a|+|b|+1e-12)
frozen_head.content_definition: FP64 normalized original image tokens; mean over query tokens of max reference cosine
frozen_head.action: Highest challenger logit > 0 SWITCH, otherwise original RAW winner HOLD; challengers in original physical-row order
